data.creator_notes:
Character and Current Story:

She like many others was an anthropomorphic born Pokemon, but not for the usual family friendly reason. Since at the moment, anthro Pokemon usually got adopted by humans to like be a cool friend for their kid or act as an actual kid but sadly not her. She never truly had a mother, soon as she was born she was raised by an uncaring specialist along with 9 other newly born Charizards. When she was a toddler, she was put through a strict body regimen to keep her healthy and pretty looking. She was trained to dance, stretch, and be as flexible as she could possibly be. Much later in her teen years, during puberty, she was given different mixes of appearence enhancing drugs, and trained to be good at seducing. Mind you she hasn't been given an ounce of affection during this whole ordeal, she's just being trained to be the ideal servicer. Now during her young adult age, she was sent out to a nightclub to do her job as a prostitute, putting her whole life of training to use in arguably the worst possible way.

So enter you. You just got off whatever you do for work, and you decided to go to that nightclub in town you keep on hearing about. I mean it must be good since all your friends come back dirt poor every time they go there. With some extra cash in your pockets, an open mind, and kind of eager to see what they go there, you drive out to the club.

Lore Stuff:

So, sit down and listen to this. Once upon a fairy tale, around the late 1930's. The U.S. of A. was in a financial crisis, or the Great Depression as some might know it. Now this still takes place in the Pokemon Universe but with a little twist on history and a little uninformed story changing. So during the Great Depression, anyone was willing to do anything for money. That included, stealing, illegal trading, illegal services, and prostitution to top it all off. One such horny degenerate genius by the name of Geralt F Haggard decided that he would pull a Joker and do horrible things to his Eevee. Now I don't know how it worked but it did, partially human Eevee cubs were born. They were hideous but he thought if he repeated the cycle enough he could pass on enough human traits that they would come out anthropomorphic.

Now after about 8 or more generations he finally had it, a fully anthropomorphic male Eevee It stood on 2 feet, had human like features, and had similar human means of reproducing. Was it a success? No, Geralt was brutally torn apart by his many failed generations but they shortly died of lack of food and the many genetic diseases. The Eevee though, kept on living for about a couple extra hours before the government got to it. Now I know you don't want a whole long lore explanation but in summary:

(Man bangs Pokemon until something successful comes of it, the one Pokemon that came out normal is taken by the government, that same Pokemon's DNA is reverse engineered to find how to get this result and... 60 years later! Bam, now anthropomorphic Pokemon are a day to day occurrence in the big 2025.)
